title: Unified Events Store Line Schema
description: JSON Schema for a single line of the append-only specs/events.jsonl event/reflection store. Each line is one compact JSON object produced via jq -c.

event_type.description: Open, extensible string naming the specific kind of event (e.g. lifecycle_stage, deviation, blocker, milestone, success, reflection). Not a closed enum -- new values may be added by future consumers.

category.description: Closed 4-value taxonomy used for aggregate filtering/grouping.

duration_seconds.description: Nullable duration in seconds. Null for point events with no duration.

session_id.description: The sess_{timestamp}_{random} value generated at command gate-in; shared cross-link key.

task.description: Bare (unpadded) task/project number, or null for non-task-scoped events.

checkpoint.description: Open, extensible string naming the lifecycle point (e.g. preflight, context_injection, verification, postflight, GATE_IN, GATE_OUT, phase_{N}), or null.

detail.description: Open, event_type-specific structured payload. Defaults to {} when absent.

error_ref.description: Optional cross-link to an errors.json entry's id. Never a hard foreign key -- always optional.

cwd.description: Nullable invoking working directory (absolute path), as captured from the originating hook/lifecycle-stage context. Null when the caller did not supply --cwd (e.g. older rows written before this field existed, or a call site with no reliable cwd source). Used by events-query.sh to derive a 'repo' value at query time for cross-repo federation -- 'repo' itself is never stored, only cwd.

cc_session_id.description: Claude Code's own native session UUID, captured verbatim from hook stdin's .session_id field. Shares an id space with OTel's session.id resource attribute and history.jsonl's sessionId -- this is the exact join key correlating an events.jsonl row to that Claude Code session's OTel telemetry stream. Distinct from this schema's session_id field, which is the agent-system's own sess_{timestamp}_{random} gate-in id; the two ids live in different id spaces and neither replaces the other. Null when the event is emitted outside any hook context (e.g. no stdin .session_id was available to the caller).
